claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the kit as a great, easy-to-use starter kit for beginners and good value for the price.
Many praise the included supplies and cute carrying case, noting it comes with everything needed including a lamp and colors.
Some reviewers find the polygel itself problematic, saying it is too thick, won't stick, or won't harden properly.
A few note the included UV/LED light is weak and suggest buying a stronger one or extra tools like a nail file separately.
Some caution it isn't as easy as it looks and requires patience and practice, especially for beginners.
